Messages.Author: delangen
Messages.Body:
HI I need a clarification on Gianni's superpower.

Gianna di Canneto

[Ally] Ally

[Giovanni] Giovanni

[1 Pool]

Unique wraith with 2 life. 1 strength, 1 bleed.
When another of your minions is in combat, Gianna can tap and burn herself to burn any equipment on the opposing minion, or tap during strike resolution to inflict 1 unpreventable damage on the opposing minion.

So am I to understand I can tap and burn her anytime one of my minions is in combat? SO even after my oponent has chosen their strike... am not sure wether the second comma means both have to be done during strike rez or if I can brun her before range... say to remove a possible gun manuever use?

Thanks

RjdL

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Gianna di Canneto
Ally
Giovanni
1 pool
Unique wraith with 2 life, 1 strength, 1 bleed.
When another of your minions is in combat, Gianna can:

Option A) Tap and burn herself to burn any equipment on the opposing minion, OR
Option B) Tap during strike resolution to inflict 1 unpreventable damage on the opposing minion.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> delangen wrote:
> When another of your minions is in combat, Gianna can tap and burn herself to burn any equipment on the opposing minion, or tap during strike resolution to inflict 1 unpreventable damage on the opposing minion.
>
> am not sure wether the second comma means both have to be done during strike rez or if I can brun her before range...
>
There's no logical way the sentence can be parsed like that. "Do X to Y, or do A during B to do C" is different from "During B, do X to Y, or do A to do C."

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
